newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Universal App to issue 167.78 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Universal App to issue 167.78 mln shares.

text.p: Universal Appliances Ltd said on Friday controlling shareholder Techral Holdings Ltd has agreed to place 80 million existing Universal Appliances shares and subscribe for 167.78 million new shares.
Techral is owned by Universal's chairman Johnson Ko.

The placement of 6.47 percent of Universal's existing share capital to private investors will be at HK$0.40 per share, while the subscription of 11.94 percent of enlarged share capital will be for a total HK$66.46 or HK$0.3961 per share.
Ko's stake in the consumer and household appliances maker will be unchanged following the placement and subscription.

Of the HK$66.4 million net proceeds raised from the subscription, the company said HK$25 million will be used to build new facilities for manufacturing telecommunication products and HK$12 million to construct new facilities for making consumer electronic products in China.
Another HK$15 million will be used to buy machineries and equipment with the balance of HK$14.4 million going to working capital.
Shares of Universal Appliances rose HK$0.035 to HK$0.465 per share in mid-morning.
